title: So Helpful! Presets are great. Daily use still going 6mth later
body: I use the app with a preset for our family’s morning routine - medicine, remember the swimming kit, clothing for sports, bike lock - all the things.  One touch and it pops up the whole list : EASY!  on the day I delete what we don’t need.   Timer options are great moving colour block/countdown numbers. Surprise me button for colours = dopamine tweak on the meh days.  Great communication from the team when I struck a little glitch - fixed up pronto.   Request please: family account!! Have multiple devices running their own timers. Daughter loves it too
author: 768waitaki

title: Really helpful
body: This app helps to keep me focused and actually get thru a number of tasks in a timely manner. It could be improved with an apple watch app so i can start/stop from my watch and also switch tasks. I wish there was not a subscription for this though. Remove that and include the watch app and it would be a 5 star review all day long
author: Megan456

title: Beautiful, truly unique and useful productivity app
body: I don’t have a bad word to say about Llama Life. I am amazed at how much value it adds in my life and I thought I had explored every productivity app under the sun. It’s useful, simple, unique and I use it everyday. Thank you.
author: georgenuri
